  CONFLICT = 'conflict'

class Authorization
  decide(action: str, resource: str) -> Decision
  decide_for(subject: Subject, action: str, resource: str) -> Decision
class AuthorizationClient(Authorization)
  __init__(transport)
  decide(action: str, resource: str) -> Decision
  decide_for(subject: Subject, action: str, resource: str) -> Decision
class AuthorizationOperator
  list_policy(cursor: str, limit: int) -> PolicyPage
  set_rule(expected_revision: str, rule: PolicyRule) -> PolicyEdit
  revoke_rule(expected_revision: str, subject: Subject, action: str, resource: str) -> PolicyEdit
  set_rule_for(expected_revision: str, rule: PolicyRule, ttl_ms: int, why: str) -> PolicyEdit
  read_rule(subject: Subject, action: str, resource: str) -> RuleRead
  register_action(expected_revision: str, action: str) -> ActionEdit
  retire_action(expected_revision: str, action: str) -> ActionEdit
class AuthorizationOperatorClient(AuthorizationOperator)
  __init__(transport)
  list_policy(cursor: str, limit: int) -> PolicyPage
  set_rule(expected_revision: str, rule: PolicyRule) -> PolicyEdit
  revoke_rule(expected_revision: str, subject: Subject, action: str, resource: str) -> PolicyEdit
  set_rule_for(expected_revision: str, rule: PolicyRule, ttl_ms: int, why: str) -> PolicyEdit
  read_rule(subject: Subject, action: str, resource: str) -> RuleRead
  register_action(expected_revision: str, action: str) -> ActionEdit
  retire_action(expected_revision: str, action: str) -> ActionEdit
